[[File:CIS_roundel.svg|thumb|right|250px|The Confederate roundel]]
The '''emblem''' of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]] was a white hexagon, with a dark blue border and six lines connecting a smaller dark blue hexagon in the center to each of the outer vertices.
